policyConstraints: Visible candidates, formed and discarded tiles only; no future wall access
No kong, wildcard, or special hand chase beyond ordinary / seven pairs
Opening 5 x <=5 with disjoint meld/head/partial protection
Opening rank/suit edits only when corresponding owned relic and ink permit
High rescue once each play phase: visible edit repair or score gain; otherwise <=3 draw exchange
Failure truncation, carry, actual rewards, fixed core, 4 slots, no purchases
Only legal settle persists growth; false-hu deducts ceil(target*0.1)
repro.bootstrap: 2000 percentile replicates; deterministic SHA256 jade-v5-bootstrap/${mode}/${route} first uint32LE seeds; LCG 1664525,1013904223

archiveVerification.note: All five archived sources exactly match their previously recorded SHA-256 hashes. No source or sample was rerun to create this archive.
archiveVerification.extractionCheck: Extract recipe executed successfully into a separate temporary directory; all five extracted files passed node --check and recorded engine hashes matched. No sampling or conditional simulation was rerun.

runtime.modules: Node ECMAScript modules; only built-in node:fs, node:fs/promises, node:crypto and the repository dist/*.js modules are required; no npm dependencies for these analysis files.

pathReplacement.portableRule: Verify archived original UTF-8 source hashes first. On extraction replace both original path literals with the chosen absolute repository root and analysis directory, including imports and output/config file paths. Relative imports between the five files stay unchanged. These intentional path substitutions change the extracted file hashes; recorded hashes apply to the originals in sourceArchive.

confirmationInvocation.note: heldTail must remain false: final confirmation uses the implemented engine held tiers directly. The optional true flag in archived sample.mjs exists only for an earlier exploratory event replay.

extractAndRunRecipe.arguments: Supply absolute jade-run repository path as argv[2] and an empty temporary analysis directory as argv[3]. Run from any working directory. Repository files must match repro.engineHashes for the original calculation.
expectedOutputs: final-confirmation-v2.json: raw summary generated by sample.mjs
extractAndRunRecipe.comparison: Compare score/survival/build numbers and seeded records, excluding createdAt, elapsedMs and random run identifiers. The stored confirmation additionally has derived bootstrap/conditional aggregation fields; these do not change sampled outcomes.

confirmationSelectionNote: Multiple exploratory candidate rounds and earlier validation informed revisions. confirmation-v2 is fresh after final constants/rules frozen and was not used to select further parameters.
